blocks.text: What pojulife is

pojulife (including POJU, Glyph, Syncro, and Match) provides AI-powered self-reflection and decision-support tools that draw on Eastern philosophical frameworks and modern psychology research. These tools generate text-based reflections in response to user input.
The tools are designed for personal exploration, journaling, and structured reflection — to help you think more clearly about questions you bring to them.
What pojulife is not
pojulife is not, and does not provide:

items.label: Medical advice.
items.text: We do not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical or mental health condition. If you have medical concerns, consult a licensed healthcare professional.

items.label: Mental health treatment.
items.text: We are not therapists, psychiatrists, or counselors. If you're experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact a qualified professional or crisis service (see "Crisis Support" below).

items.label: Legal advice.
items.text: We do not provide legal counsel. For legal questions, consult a licensed attorney in your jurisdiction.

items.label: Financial or investment advice.
items.text: We do not provide guidance on investments, taxes, or financial planning. Consult a licensed financial advisor.

items.label: Guarantees of future outcomes.
items.text: Our tools do not guarantee events, outcomes, or future circumstances. AI-generated reflections are for thinking through questions, not assurances.

items.label: Supernatural claims.
items.text: pojulife uses Eastern philosophical frameworks as a conceptual structure for reflection — similar to how cognitive behavioral therapy uses frameworks for examining thought patterns. We make no claims of supernatural insight.

items.label: A substitute for professional consultation, human relationships, or your own judgment.
items.text: Our tools are designed to complement, not replace, professional advisors and the people in your life.

blocks.text: Your responsibility
You alone are responsible for:

items: All decisions you make based on, around, or after using pojulife.
Verifying any information that pojulife provides before acting on it.
Seeking appropriate professional guidance for serious matters (medical, legal, financial, mental health, etc.).
Using pojulife in a manner consistent with your local laws and your own values.

blocks.text: We do not guarantee any specific outcome from using pojulife. AI-generated text is, by nature, probabilistic and imperfect. We expect users to apply critical judgment to anything our tools produce.
Cultural and philosophical frameworks

pojulife draws conceptually from Eastern philosophical traditions, including the I Ching (Book of Changes) and related classical frameworks. We treat these as cultural and philosophical resources for thinking — similar to how a therapist might draw on concepts from Carl Jung and how a strategist might draw on Sun Tzu.

We do not present these traditions as supernatural systems or as having power to determine real-world events. Any traditional terminology is used purely as analytical vocabulary, much as psychologists use terms like "attachment style" or "locus of control."
Age requirement
pojulife is intended for users 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly serve users under 18. If you believe a minor has used pojulife, please contact privacy@pojulife.com.
AI-generated content
All reflective text generated by pojulife is produced by artificial intelligence (specifically, large language models from Anthropic). AI-generated content:

items: May contain errors, inaccuracies, or inconsistencies.
Reflects patterns learned from training data, not ground truth.
Should not be relied upon as authoritative on any subject.
Is provided for personal reflection only.

blocks.text: Crisis support
If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, suicidal thoughts, or thoughts of harming yourself or others, please contact a qualified crisis service immediately:

items: United States: 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — call or text, 24/7)
EU general: 116 123 or local emergency services

blocks.text: pojulife is not equipped to handle mental health emergencies. Please reach out to someone trained to help.
